notes.title: SoBFM v1.7 now available!
notes.notes:
The new game update includes bug fixing and some minor improvements, but the main change is the updated game engine to improve performance and new devices compatibility.

[b]Note[/b]: We detected some issues with some generic gamepads. Please, join the beta "Legacy" if this happens to you to play with the old engine version.

[i]This update if for Windows devices only.[/i]

Happy festive season and happy New year 2020 with the Bethem Witches!

notes.title: New features in Stories of Bethem: Full Moon v1.3.7!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10916533/72700b805034b7b9b1a56bbdf10ed77c26f3ac4c.png[/img]

We have released a new game update with improvements and bug fixes. Discover what's new in Stories of Bethem: Full Moon v1.3.7!

Remember that you can check the fixed bugs in the game [url=http://support.gugames-dev.com/en/bugboxes/stories-of-bethem-full-moon#v1.3.7]Bug box[/url]. SOBFM v1.3.7 fixes gamepad bugs, crashing when pausing the game and other minor issues.

[h1]Disable screen smoothing[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10916533/6281742c714f02706b3c88063810dcdeebb0531d.jpg[/img]
The most important content of this update is the option to disable screen smoothing (solid pixels). Take a look at the Config menu and choose what you like most!

If you disable screen smoothing, you'll probably see broken square proportions depending on your screen aspect ratio and resolution.

[h1]Minor improvements[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10916533/306299346bf8d162289a0e507db8080411016315.jpg[/img]
The update includes some minor improvements:
[list]
[*] [b]New sound for text boxes.[/b] Text boxes will only play the chime sound when the dialogue is over. More comfortable now!
[*] [b]New tips.[/b] There are new tips in many points of the adventure.
[/list]

[h1]Thank you[/h1]
We want to thank to all user who helped us to improve the game with their feedback one more time. We love you!

notes.title: Select your favorite gamepad settings!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10916533/891f79a8adbb084a9d79622a8c3946eca6990e76.png[/img]
We released the update v1.3.3 for Stories of Bethem: Full Moon for Windows and OS X (tomorrow it will be also available for Ubuntu). 

This update includes an important change for gamepads. Please take a look at the config option of the title screen!

[h1]Choose your favorite settings for Xbox (Xinput) controllers[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10916533/9a75ed0660ef158254bb63a1f902fb74be749a0b.png[/img]
Now you can choose one of the four settings for this kind of gamepad. It includes the first configuration we released, the new one (now by default, take a look at the screenshot above), the config of v1.3.2 and a new one.

We included the new gamepad setting after testing for the most comfortable and fast gameplay. But maybe you don't like it.

So go to config -> gamepad and select what you like most!

[h1]Generic gamepads and the Xbox controller reference[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10916533/a51b5c5c2dede85184ed9be8217241e05cd15278.png[/img]
We added a reference model as suggestion for generic gamepad config. These controllers are fully configurable because the button number changes between devices.

But we thought that maybe you would want to know about the standard setting.

[h1]More info about the update[/h1]
This update includes a lot of bug fixing and some improvements.

We'll inform deeper about this patch tomorrow, when we release it on Ubuntu. Sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: New patch available to fix a major issue + improvements
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10916533/a6b9fa5ac5b2e226d0c9e5308f7b708a40c86fb3.png[/img]

We have released Stories of Bethem: Full Moon v1.3.2 for Windows, Ubuntu and OS X. It contains a fix for an important error that only happens starting your game in v1.3.0, minor bug fixing and a couple of minor improvements and adjustments.

One of these improvements is the new recycling screen: we can choose how many items we want to introduce in the machines now. Take a look at the following screenshot!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10916533/40afd7344c351945ff69096094bdcaff82b880fa.png[/img]

We also made easier that some monsters drop their aura.

[h1]The major issue[/h1]
After talking to the Red Witch for the first time, you shouldn't be able to go to the West area. There, an event will be triggered and the game line will go a little crazy. If you save the game after this, your game will be altered forever.

When you get the first Oneiric Object in the Warehouse, you won't be able to know what the Red Witch was to tell you. She is just angry and you'll never know why.

[h1]What can I expect if this happened to me?[/h1]
Don't worry! The game should works fine if you complete the first dungeon before the second.

You'll have got too many gems to ruin your trades (and a part of your game, because finding gems makes no sense then). 

[h1]Can I fix it?[/h1]
You can send us your saved game at our support e-mail and we'll cast a new spell on your gems if you want. If you haven't got the first Oneiric Object yet and you went to the West area, consider as a choice starting.

Don't hesitate to contact us if you want us to destroy your gems :P

[h1]Why?[/h1]
We tried to make the game opening faster for the player, so we removed a couple of irrelevant scenes with the last update. We forgot to cast the anti-bug spell and the terrible bug was born ːredcriesː

More info: http://support.gugames-dev.com/en/stories-of-bethem-full-moon#topic1

[h1]Our apologies[/h1]
We are so sorry for this. Don't hesitate to contact us if you want to "fix" your gems.

Thanks to Yannick and Fancore for the bug discovery and helping us to fix it.

notes.title: A lot of improvements in Stories of Bethem: Full Moon v1.3.
notes.notes:
We have released a new version of the game with a lot of improvements. Discover what's new in Stories of Bethem: Full Moon v1.3!

At first, the update fixes some bugs you can check in the game [url=http://support.gugames-dev.com/en/bugboxes/stories-of-bethem-full-moon#v1.3.0]Bug box[/url]. So we'll just show you the rest of improvements in this article.


[h1]Game progress[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10916533/82fe5044c6956baf6914bd4a79b479213633911b.png[/img]

The saving/load screen shows the game progress now. Know easily how you are you doing in the game!

Note that you'll have to load and save the game with the new update to this information be shown.


[h1]Gamepad changes[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10916533/689925df87d06e95735d924713168471e7fcce19.png[/img]

We updated the default buttons for generic gamepads and the Xbox controller configuration. The [b]Start button is now used to pause the game, Select to display information and X to open the inventory and map[/b].

Before the update, Start was used to open the inventory/map, Select to pause the game and X to display information. We decided to change the configuration because we thought it's better to use the face buttons for the main features and the pause menu be open with the Start button.


[h1]Buy as many potions as you want at once[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10916533/413a6db3cc38f46356dc34a3962fe0c7d4f654bd.png[/img]

Yeah! No more talking to the merchant for each potion you want to buy. Some users told to us this tedious issue and they were right, so we have been working on improving the shop system.

Just select the item, and the new buying screen will be displayed. Choose the units you want to buy with by pressing up and down buttons. Remember your inventory has a limit per potion!

The new buying screen will be displayed for all the merchant activities (costumes, potions, items, orbs...).


[h1]Pause and exit at any moment[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10916533/8922707d97949be8e96365c64687e2431cbb2070.png[/img]

Previously, the game only let us open the pause menu when Khoma was able to move: for example, we couldn't do it in a scene.

This won't be a problem anymore! Pause the game when you need to.


[h1]New Yellow Potion making screen[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10916533/36b99636a98c46dbbe49e0b93cf378adbdcb73d0.png[/img]

Before the update, Crisantemo said us what ingredients we didn't have got in her speaking bubble.

That was tedious too, so we have tried to make a new screen where the ingredients will be displayed in a useful way.


[h1]Sound improvement[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10916533/2294a12dee1a575281594a779a3f615a24974bb8.png[/img]

We normalized the audio volume and improved the bit rate. That's why the game size is now about 150 MB.


[h1]New trading screen[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10916533/ab4b248a07d1a122d2d4fab613e2d51b4e47362d.png[/img]

The trading screen has also been improved and doesn't show only the two options we have: it displays the elements being trading.


[h1]Minor adjustments[/h1]

We also made the followings adjustments:
[list][*]Bat animations improvements.
[*]GuGames Development logo resolution improvement.
[*]Simultaneous sound limitations. No more bushes destruction or spell collision/cast high volume sound.
[*]Spells collision improvements. Hitting balloons is easier now.[/list]


[h1]Download it now![/h1]

We want to [b]thank to all user who helped us to improve the game with their feedback[/b]. You are great!

Download the update now to enjoy all this new features!

notes.title: Small update + cross-platform Steam Cloud!
notes.notes:
We released a small update for Stories of Bethem: Full Moon and its demo version. In addition, you are able to continue your game from different platforms if you have Steam Cloud enabled now because saved files are synchronized between platforms too.

Explore, solve puzzles and have fun wherever you want!

List of improvements:
[list][*] Bug fixing.
[*] Costume price adjustment.
[*] Saving directories are now lowercase.
[*] New logo of GuGames Development shown when loading.
[*] New streetlights.
[*] Graphical optimization.
[/list]

Check the fixed bugs at the [url=http://support.gugames-dev.com/bugboxes/stories-of-bethem-full-moon#v1.2.2]GuGames Bux Box[/url].

We also updated the game trailer to add the costumes and improve some elements.

Thanks for your attention. Have fun!

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards and new quests on Stories of Bethem: Full Moon v1.2
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that the new game expansion and Trading Cards are now available for the game. Install the new update to enjoy the new features!

We added four new achievements to unlock. There are 52 achievements to get now!

[h1]Powerful costumes[/h1]
The main new feature of the game is the Blossom's Taylor Shop. A place where you'll be able to change the clothes of Khoma and get new special powers.

For example, you can use the Goat Costume to be inmune to the holes: Khoma can't fall into them! Each costume has a special power, take a look at the Blossom's Taylor Shop at The Cape.

[h1]New dungeon[/h1]
Two of the seven costumes are very special: they are ancestral costumes and are not sold by Blossom. You'll have to discover them.

One of them is waiting for you in a new dungeon. The other one... You'll have to investigate!

The new dungeon is pretty special because there are no monsters inside. It's a misleading-puzzle based challenge where you must be careful with all stuff inside. We hope you enjoy!

[h1]Visual improvements[/h1]
We also improved some of the game animations and graphics. Among other things, Birky is now prettier, gems have been remade, NPC and Khoma have been updated too. We hope you like them!

You can take a look at the fixed issues in the game [url=http://support.gugames-dev.com/bugboxes/stories-of-bethem-full-moon#v1.2.1]Bug Box[/url].

Update your game and enjoy the new free content while you get the Steam Trading Cards!

notes.title: The new update that includes WASD mode is now available
notes.notes:
The new update (v1.1.6) fixes some bugs and improves the compatibility with some devices. But the main new features are the WASD keyboard mode and the Steam overlay now fixed on Mac OS X.

[h1]How to change the keyboard mode[/h1]
Change the keyboard mode on the Config option of the main screen. You must disconnect the gamepad to enable the mode changing.

notes.title: Stories of Bethem: Full Moon v1.1.4 available!
notes.notes:
There is a new update available for SOBFM that fixes all the reported bugs by users. It also includes the following features!

[h1]Title and loading screen[/h1]
The Title Screen is new and colorful! Loading screen has been changed too, now it'll display different backgrounds depending on if you completed the game. Thanks to Miriam Pérez for the nice art!

[url]http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=617221571[/url]
[url]http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=617223421[/url]

[h1]Steam Cloud[/h1]
The game uses the Steam Cloud service now. You can continue your game in other device if you synchronized it.

We've tried very hard to make a cross platform, but finally we weren't be able to do. This means you can synchronize saved games on the same OS via Steam Cloud, they don't override between them.

We'll keep working and announce if we get it!

Update your copy and enjoy the latest features.

[url]http://store.steampowered.com/app/412270/[/url]

- At this moment, we only provide support for gamepads on Windows platforms, maybe they work on other platforms but we can't ensure. Sorry for the inconvenience.

Have fun!

notes.title: Fixing the Steam crashing issue EDITED 22/12
notes.notes:
Hello, friends.

Seems like we found the problem thanks to the users' help.

[h1]The issue[/h1]
Some players reported us that when they start the game, this doesn't work and the Steam client crashes.

[h1]Why does this happen?[/h1]
Some antivirus don't let complete the game installation (the case we know is AVAST!).

[b]UPDATED:[/b] Seems like the game can't run with this antivirus enabled and not configured for Steam. It doesn't only interfere with the installation process.

[h1]How to fix it[/h1] 
Just disable your antivirus software when you're going to install and play the game or configure it to work with Steam. Before disabling it, we recommend to look for other antivirus software alternative, but the best option is configure it.

If you disable your antivirus software for playing with Steam, you should enable it when you finish to protect your PC.

Take a look at the Steam article about [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=9828-SFLZ-9289]Programs Which May Interfere with Steam[/url] and [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=6057-YLBN-1660]Spyware, Malware, Adware, or Virus Interfering with Steam[/url].

Sorry for the inconvenience.

Have a nice day and enjoy with the Red Witch & Khoma.

[url=http://www.gugames-dev.com/support/StoriesOfBethemFullMoon#topic1]Read this on GuGames DEV[/url] (Spanish and English).
